svg.title: Starting an invoice from a job's page
svg.text: Starting an invoice from a job's page
6.1 promised a New invoice link in the task page's Invoices section, but that section hides when the job has no invoice, which is exactly when you'd want the link.
A. New invoice in the task's ⋯ menu
Above Copy link and Delete task; opens New invoice with this job ticked. There at every invoice count, no empty section.
Start from Invoices' New invoice and pick the job, or use Use as invoice on a job file. Nothing on the task page.
C. Show the Invoices section on every job
An empty 'No invoice yet.' section with New invoice on every job, chores included.
A: the task's ⋯ holds Copy link and Delete task today (tasks/[id]/header.tsx); New invoice goes first.
C puts an empty section on jobs that will never have an invoice (property taxes, chores).
